senses.gloss: m.(h. מָגוֹשׁ)magus, magian, a Persian priest and interpreter of dreams; magician, sorcerer.
units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 7:15">Targ. Y. I Ex. VII, 15</cite>; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 8:16">VIII, 16</cite>.—B. Beth. 58ᵃ.
<cite ref="Yoma 35a:1">Yoma 35ᵃ</cite> (<cite ref="Chullin 62b:8">Ḥull. 62ᵇ</cite>) <he>פרוה א׳</he> Parvah is the name of a Persian magus after whom the cell in the Temple was named.—
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 98a:9">Snh. 98ᵃ</cite> <he>אי בטלי יהירי בטלי א׳</he> when (in Israel) the haughty shall cease to exist, the magians (among the Persians) shall cease.
